SELECT * FROM ( SELECT ID, BATCH_ID, REQUEST_ID, PARK_ID, TARGET_KEY, SUBJECT_TYPE, SUBJECT_ID, SUBJECT_SNAPSHOT, RESOURCE_TYPE, DEVICE_ID, RESOURCE_ID, ACCESS_TYPE, OPERATION_QUEUE, ACTION, VALID_FROM, VALID_TO, OPERATION_VERSION, LEGACY_TASK_ID, STATE, RESULT_SUMMARY, FAILURE_REASON, ACCEPTED_AT, DISPATCHED_AT, CONFIRMED_AT, CONVERGED_AT, LEASE_TOKEN, LEASE_UNTIL, NEXT_ATTEMPT_AT, CREATE_TIME, UPDATE_TIME FROM SMT_AUTH_OPERATION_TARGET WHERE PARK_ID = #{parkId} AND OPERATION_QUEUE = #{operationQueue} AND STATE = 'QUEUED' AND (NEXT_ATTEMPT_AT IS NULL OR NEXT_ATTEMPT_AT <= #{now}) AND (LEASE_UNTIL IS NULL OR LEASE_UNTIL < #{now}) ORDER BY NEXT_ATTEMPT_AT NULLS FIRST, ID ) WHERE ROWNUM <= #{maxCount}
